text: Don’t practice the same thing again without knowing what you’re trying to get out of it (and how you’d know if you got it). You might end the practice feeling great with all kinds of insight but if you’re not solving the original problem, you’re wasting your time. If you find that what you’re doing isn’t connecting in a useful way, or only seems to be helping you engage in more self-monitoring while making everything else worse in your life, then try something else (while still keeping what’s helpful).
